title: Choose the visual world for the ICSIFT home page
question: The roll assigned Skytrain Line. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Skytrain Line
options.lineage: Bangkok BTS Skytrain and MRT wayfinding
options.thesis: The conference as a route through Bangkok: every deadline is a station; the event is the interchange where the in-person and virtual lines meet.
options.viewport: A green station sign, 'Next stop: Sustainable Innovation, Bangkok', with Submit and Register as ticket gates, over a full-width route line whose stations are the live important dates.
options.risk: Reads as a transit-app costume if the signage type is timid or the route line becomes decoration instead of the dates.

raised.raise: Line colours own whole section fields (green sign, blue virtual band), never sprinkled as accents.
Every date station shows its state: departed, next with a live countdown, or upcoming.
Platform-edge yellow is reserved for the next stop and the primary gate only.

options.label: Proceedings Issue
options.lineage: academic journal covers and tables of contents
options.thesis: The edition as a journal issue: a drenched cover per edition, the page as its table of contents, ending in indexed publication.
options.viewport: A vermilion issue cover on deep green beside the contents of the 4th edition, Submit and Register under the contents.
options.risk: Familiar: the academic-publishing look is where many runs in this category land, and it skews serif-editorial.

options.label: Highlife Sleeve
options.thesis: The edition as a tropical record sleeve with painted lettering.
options.viewport: Arced hand-brushed ICSIFT over saturated colour fields.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scholars weighing indexed publication do not identify with a party sleeve.
options.kept: Total colour commitment: colour owns whole regions.

options.label: Night-flight Six-pack
options.thesis: Six gauges for the conference's six truths.
options.viewport: Six dials: deadlines, CPD, awards, countries.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an instrument panel hides the offer behind readings.
options.risk: Dashboard costume on a marketing page.
options.kept: Every value shows its state, not just a number.

options.label: Paper Menagerie
options.thesis: A procession of cut-paper figures driven by one crank.
options.viewport: A crank line with a figure for each conference stage.
options.case: Fuses poorly: whimsical craft does not carry indexing or dates clearly.
options.kept: One reserved colour only for the item currently in motion.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conference landing page as the category ships it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero with dates, venue and two buttons, then highlights, dates, speakers.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other conference site by design.
